verdict.rationale: Building and configuring custom AI agents is a fair question for a project-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows adjacent capabilities: delegating an issue to Copilot (a prebuilt agent), built-in field-setting workflows, and API, Actions or MCP building blocks. None of these is a documented in-product custom-agent builder.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build and configure my own custom AI agent within the product
